question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Over the last 4 quarters NVIDIA's next-quarter guide ran ~12-15% above the just-reported actual (Q1 FY27 81.6 -> Q2 guide 91; Q2 96.2 -> Q3 guide 108), and actuals beat the guide by ~$3-5B. Q3 is likely ~$112-114B (previews; the Polymarket Data Center ladder implies DC ~105-106B). An 11-14% step gives ~$125-129B. Supply constraints through FY28, rising memory costs and no China revenue in guidance temper the step; the 70% FY28 growth outlook and a history of guiding above consensus support it. No market on the Q4 guide was found; FY27 consensus ~$411.65B implies Q4 ~$122B.

- Vera Rubin expected ~20% of DC revenue in Q3 FY27 (Fool, Nov 2026).
